title: Scrapegraph AI launches free web scraping tool for easy #ScrapegraphAI #opensource #webscraping
description: Scrapegraph AI launched a free, open-source Python library that extracts data from websites using plain English prompts. With over 30,000 stars on GitHub, it enables users to gather leads, monitor competitors, or conduct research effortlessly. This tool integrates with popular AI coding agents like Claude Code, highlighting the rapid evolution of practical AI applications. It reflects a shift toward accessible, no-cost solutions for data scraping, lowering barriers for businesses and researchers alike. As adoption grows, Scrapegraph AI could reshape how companies collect competitive intelligence and insights, accelerating data-driven decision-making in marketing and sales. #ScrapegraphAI #OpenSourceAI #PythonLibrary #DataScraping #AIAutomation #ClaudeCode #LeadGeneration #CompetitiveIntelligence #AItools #TechInnovation #GitHubStars #DataResearch #AIDevelopment #AIintegration #FreeAItools
